name.en: Prepare the plank boat and fishing gear

text.seasonEn: Late in the wait for flying fish season

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩接下工作：準備拼板舟與漁具
steps.textEn: The Tao man takes a job from the man elder: prepare the plank boat and fishing gear

lines.zh: 飛魚季快到了，船和漁具要先整理好。跟著船組的人去港邊看看。
lines.en: Flying fish season is coming. The boat and gear need sorting first. Go with the boat crew to the harbour.

lines.zh: 船組怎麼分工、哪些事只有船組的人能做，還要請族人確認。
lines.en: How the crew splits the work, and which tasks only crew members can do, still needs checking with the community.

steps.text: 族男到開元港邊，跟船組一起整理拼板舟與漁具
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes to Kaiyuan Harbour to sort the plank boat and fishing gear with the boat crew

lines.zh: 船身擦乾淨，漁網一段一段檢查，破的地方記下來。
lines.en: Wipe the hull clean, check the net section by section and note the torn spots.

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩回報：船和漁具整理好了
steps.textEn: The Tao man reports to the man elder: the boat and gear are ready

lines.zh: 整理好了就好，等飛魚季開始。
lines.en: Good, all sorted. Now we wait for flying fish season.

hint.zh: 男性長輩要族男去港邊，跟船組整理拼板舟和漁具。
hint.en: The man elder wants the Tao man to go to the harbour and sort the plank boat and gear with the crew.

name.en: Imorod announces the flying fish season

text.coop: 不需到場，只顯示季節開始
text.coopEn: No need to be there; just shows the season starting
text.unlock: 紅頭進入飛魚季，其他部落之後各自切換
text.unlockEn: Imorod enters flying fish season; the other villages follow on their own

steps.text: 飛魚季開始（只顯示季節，不需到場）
steps.textEn: Flying fish season begins (shows the season only, no need to be there)

hint.zh: 飛魚季開始時，這一步會自己完成。
hint.en: This step completes by itself when flying fish season starts.

name.en: Go to sea for flying fish

text.season: 飛魚季（以當地部落為準）
text.seasonEn: Flying fish season (by the local village)
text.pre: M1、M2、OF1（傳統服飾；MS1 三人分頭準備為選做）
text.preEn: M1, M2, OF1 (traditional clothing; MS1 three-way preparation is optional)

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩接下出海的工作
steps.textEn: The Tao man takes the job of going to sea from the man elder

lines.zh: 飛魚季到了，跟船組出海。這趟只有你去，其他人在岸邊等。
lines.en: Flying fish season is here. Go out with the boat crew. Only you go this time; the others wait on shore.

lines.zh: 穿上家裡織的衣服再來。上船出海，是很重要的事。
lines.en: Put on the clothes woven at home first. Going out to sea on a boat is a serious thing.

lines.zh: 看準時機，不行就回來，不要逞強。
lines.en: Watch for the right moment. If it doesn't work, come back. Don't push yourself.

lines.zh: 依傳統，飛魚季出海捕魚由男子負責。遊戲裡只做時機練習；真正的漁團與規矩還要請族人確認。
lines.en: By tradition, men go to sea for flying fish. The game only has a timing practice; the real crews and rules still need checking with the community.

lines.zh: 出海期間只能操控族男。捕到魚，或按「放棄出海」，才會回岸邊和大家會合。
lines.en: While at sea, you can only control the Tao man. Catch a fish, or tap "Give up", to return to shore and rejoin everyone.

solo.taskEn: Go to sea for flying fish

steps.text: 族男划拼板舟出海，看準飛魚躍出的時機（失敗可再試，或放棄出海）
steps.textEn: The Tao man paddles the plank boat out and waits for the moment a flying fish leaps (try again if you miss, or give up)

lines.zh: 捕到了！划回岸邊。
lines.en: Caught one! Paddle back to shore.

steps.text: 族男回到岸邊，和族女、旅人會合
steps.textEn: The Tao man returns to shore and meets up with the Tao woman and the traveller

lines.zh: 回來了！平安就好。
lines.en: You're back! As long as you're safe.

lines.zh: 辛苦了！我們在岸邊一直看著。
lines.en: Well done! We were watching from the shore the whole time.

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩回報：平安回來了
steps.textEn: The Tao man reports to the man elder: back safely

lines.zh: 平安回來最重要。漁獲怎麼分，下次再教你。
lines.en: Coming back safe matters most. I'll teach you how to share the catch next time.

hint.zh: 飛魚季時，男性長輩會叫族男出海；只有族男能去，其他人在岸邊等。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the man elder will send the Tao man to sea. Only the Tao man can go; the others wait on shore.

name.zh: 回灘頭處理與分配漁獲
name.en: Back to the beach to clean and share the catch

steps.text: 族男向男性長輩報到，回灘頭處理漁獲
steps.textEn: The Tao man reports to the man elder and goes back to the beach to clean the catch

lines.zh: 魚帶回來了，要先在灘頭處理好，再一起分。
lines.en: The fish are back. Clean them on the beach first, then we share.

steps.text: 族男跟船組在灘頭把漁獲平均分好
steps.textEn: The Tao man and the boat crew share the catch evenly on the beach

lines.zh: 船組每個人一份，一條一條數清楚。
lines.en: One share for each person in the crew. Count them out one by one.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的漁獲，按船組的人數分。誰多拿、誰少拿，大家都看得到。
lines.en: The flying fish catch is shared by the number of people in the crew. Everyone can see who gets more or less.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報：漁獲分好了
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder: the catch is shared

lines.zh: 分得公平，船組才會長久。把魚帶回家，交給家裡的女人。
lines.en: Fair sharing keeps a crew together for a long time. Take the fish home and give them to the women of the house.

toastEn: The catch was shared on the beach.

hint.zh: 族男出海回來後，要回灘頭跟船組處理、分配漁獲。
hint.en: After the Tao man comes back from sea, he goes back to the beach to clean and share the catch with the crew.

review: 漁獲在灘頭依船組人數平均分配的做法請族人確認

name.en: Hand over the flying fish and sort them by kind

text.whoEn: Tao man hands over, Tao woman takes over
text.coop: 雙人：族男＋族女，在家屋前
text.coopEn: Pair: Tao man + Tao woman, in front of the house

steps.text: 族男把分到的飛魚帶回家，交給族女
steps.textEn: The Tao man brings his share of flying fish home and gives it to the Tao woman

lines.zh: 這是今天船組分到的魚。
lines.en: This is the crew's share for today.

lines.zh: 交給我。我跟長輩一起處理。
lines.en: Give them to me. I'll sort them with the elder.

steps.text: 族女跟女性長輩把飛魚依種類分開
steps.textEn: The Tao woman and the woman elder sort the flying fish by kind

lines.zh: 飛魚有好幾種，不同的分開放。怎麼分、誰可以吃，聽長輩的，不要自己決定。
lines.en: There are several kinds of flying fish. Keep each kind apart. How to sort them and who can eat which — follow the elder, don't decide yourself.

lines.zh: 好，我照您說的放。
lines.en: Okay, I'll lay them out the way you said.

toast: 漁獲交接完成，接下來要曬魚。
toastEn: The catch is handed over. Next, the fish need drying.

hint.zh: 族男把漁獲帶回家，交給族女和女性長輩分類。
hint.en: The Tao man brings the catch home and gives it to the Tao woman and the woman elder to sort.

quests.labourNote: 族男把魚帶回家交給族女，是 M4 之後的交接：男性長輩交辦，女性長輩接手
review: 飛魚種類的分法與哪些人可以吃，請族人確認

name.en: Dry the fish and store them

text.unlockEn: Food store, dried flying fish card

steps.text: 女性長輩交代族女曬魚
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks the Tao woman to dry the fish

lines.zh: 天氣好，把魚剖開、抹鹽，掛到曬魚架上。
lines.en: Good weather. Split the fish, rub in salt and hang them on the drying rack.

steps.text: 族女把飛魚一條條掛上曬魚架
steps.textEn: The Tao woman hangs the flying fish on the drying rack one by one

lines.zh: 剖開、洗乾淨、抹鹽，一條一條掛好。
lines.en: Split, wash, salt, and hang them up one by one.

lines.zh: 曬魚架上的魚，是一家人一整年的糧食。外人不要隨便碰。
lines.en: The fish on the drying rack are a family's food for the whole year. Outsiders shouldn't touch them.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder

lines.zh: 曬好了就收進糧倉。今年的飛魚乾，就從這裡開始。
lines.en: Once dry, put them in the food store. This year's dried flying fish starts here.

toastEn: The dried flying fish are in the food store.

hint.zh: 飛魚分好之後，族女要把魚曬在主人家的曬魚架上。
hint.en: After the flying fish are sorted, the Tao woman dries them on the host family's drying rack.

text.unlockEn: Boiled flying fish recipe card, M9

steps.text: 女性長輩請族女準備家裡的晚餐
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks the Tao woman to make the family dinner

lines.zh: 今天煮飛魚。用清水煮就好，不要加別的東西。
lines.en: Flying fish today. Just boil it in plain water. Don't add anything else.

steps.text: 族女在主人家煮一鍋水煮飛魚
steps.textEn: The Tao woman cooks a pot of boiled flying fish at the host family's house

lines.zh: 水滾了，魚放下去，再煮一下就好。
lines.en: When the water boils, put the fish in and cook a little longer.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的餐點，鍋子和做法都有規矩；各家的做法不同，還要請族人確認。
lines.en: Meals in flying fish season have rules about pots and methods. Each family is different; this still needs checking with the community.

steps.text: 請女性長輩嚐嚐
steps.textEn: Ask the woman elder to taste it

lines.zh: 煮得剛好。叫大家回來吃飯吧。
lines.en: Just right. Call everyone home to eat.

hint.zh: 女性長輩會請族女在飛魚季煮家裡的餐點。
hint.en: In flying fish season, the woman elder will ask the Tao woman to cook the family meal.

text.coop: 雙人：旅人＋任一族人，在部落外圍
text.coopEn: Pair: Traveller + any Tao member, outside the village

steps.text: 長輩請旅人今天到部落外走走
steps.textEn: The elder asks the traveller to spend today outside the village

lines.zh: 今天灘頭在處理漁獲，外面的人不要靠近。你們去部落外面走走，傍晚再回來。
lines.en: They're cleaning the catch on the beach today, so outsiders should stay away. Go for a walk outside the village and come back in the evening.

steps.text: 旅人和族人到南邊的青青草原
steps.textEn: The traveller and a Tao member go to Qingqing Prairie in the south

lines.zh: 從這裡看海，就不會打擾到灘頭的人。
lines.en: Looking at the sea from here, we won't bother the people on the beach.

lines.zh: 小時候放暑假回來，我們也常被叫到這裡玩，不要去灘頭搗蛋。
lines.en: When we came back for summer holidays as kids, we were often sent here to play, so we wouldn't make trouble on the beach.

steps.text: 傍晚回到主人家
steps.textEn: Return to the host family in the evening

lines.zh: 回來啦。你們懂得讓開，大家都看在眼裡。
lines.en: You're back. Everyone noticed you knew to give them space.

toast: 飛魚季時懂得讓開，部落的人都看到了。
toastEn: The village saw that you knew to give space in flying fish season.

hint.zh: 飛魚季灘頭最忙的日子，長輩會請旅人到部落外面走走。
hint.en: On the beach's busiest days in flying fish season, the elder will ask the traveller to go for a walk outside the village.

review: 飛魚季時訪客避開灘頭、到部落外走走的安排請族人確認

text.coopEn: Trio: whole party at the host family's house

steps.text: 全隊回到主人家，一起吃飯
steps.textEn: The whole party returns to the host family to eat together

lines.zh: 大家都回來了，坐下來吃飯。
lines.en: Everyone's back. Sit down and eat.

lines.zh: 海上的、田裡的、外面學到的，今天都在這張桌上了。
lines.en: What came from the sea, the fields and what we learned outside — it's all on this table today.

lines.zh: 一整天都在忙，原來一頓飯是這樣來的。
lines.en: Busy all day. So this is how a meal comes together.

steps.text: 飯後聽主人家長輩說話
steps.textEn: Listen to the host family elder after the meal

lines.zh: 一家人一起吃飯，就是飛魚季最重要的事。
lines.en: A family eating together — that's the most important thing in flying fish season.

toast: 飛魚季的一天圓滿結束。
toastEn: A day of flying fish season ends well.

hint.zh: 魚煮好了，旅人也回來了，全隊回主人家一起吃飯。
hint.en: The fish is cooked and the traveller is back. The whole party returns to the host family to eat together.

name.en: Storing flying fish (name to be confirmed)

steps.text: 女性長輩交代把曬好的飛魚乾收起來
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks you to put away the dried flying fish

lines.zh: 曬好的飛魚乾要收起來，一種一種放好，算一算夠吃多久。
lines.en: Put away the dried flying fish, each kind in its place, and work out how long it will last.

steps.text: 族女把飛魚乾從曬魚架收進來
steps.textEn: The Tao woman brings the dried flying fish in from the drying rack

lines.zh: 乾了，硬硬的。一串一串收好。
lines.en: Dry and hard. Put them away string by string.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder

lines.zh: 收好了。等飛魚終食那天，再看看剩多少。
lines.en: All stored. On the day flying fish season ends, we'll see how much is left.

toast: 糧倉裡的飛魚乾整理好了。
toastEn: The dried flying fish in the food store are sorted.

hint.zh: 飛魚乾曬好之後，女性長輩會請族女收藏起來。
hint.en: Once the flying fish are dry, the woman elder will ask the Tao woman to store them.

review: 飛魚乾的收藏方式與名稱請族人確認

name.en: End of flying fish (name to be confirmed)

text.unlockEn: "Just right" count, Z1, next game year

steps.text: 飛魚季結束（只顯示季節，不需到場）
steps.textEn: Flying fish season ends (shows the season only, no need to be there)

lines.zh: 飛魚季到了尾聲。各部落依長輩的決定，迎來飛魚終食的日子。
lines.en: Flying fish season is coming to an end. Each village, as the elders decide, reaches the day flying fish are eaten for the last time.

lines.zh: 這一天之後，今年的飛魚就告一段落，大家等明年飛魚再來。確切的日子和做法，各部落不同。
lines.en: After this day, this year's flying fish are done, and everyone waits for them to return next year. The exact day and customs differ by village.

toastEn: This year's flying fish season is over.

hint.zh: 飛魚季結束時，這一步會自己完成。
hint.en: This step completes by itself when flying fish season ends.

review: 飛魚終食的時間、意義與之後是否還能吃飛魚乾，各部落說法不同，請族人確認

name.zh: 辨認女人魚、男人魚、老人魚
name.en: Tell women's fish, men's fish and elders' fish apart

text.whoEn: Tao man catches, Tao woman prepares
text.unlock: 魚類圖鑑、水煮女人魚料理卡、F2
text.unlockEn: Fish field guide, boiled women's fish recipe card, F2

steps.text: 男性長輩說明魚的分類
steps.textEn: The man elder explains how fish are sorted

lines.zh: 魚有分：女人可以吃的、男人吃的，還有只有老人吃的。
lines.en: Fish are sorted: some women can eat, some men eat, and some only elders eat.

lines.zh: 捕的時候就要分清楚，拿回家才不會放錯鍋子。
lines.en: Sort them when you catch them, so they don't end up in the wrong pot at home.

steps.text: 族男在港邊的礁岩釣魚
steps.textEn: The Tao man fishes from the rocks by the harbour

lines.zh: 釣到了！這條顏色好亮。
lines.en: Got one! This one's so bright.

steps.text: 族女跟女性長輩把魚分類
steps.textEn: The Tao woman and the woman elder sort the fish

lines.zh: 這條是女人魚，給我們煮；那條是男人魚，另外放。
lines.en: This one is a women's fish — it's for us to cook. That one is a men's fish; keep it apart.

lines.zh: 我記住了，看顏色和形狀分。
lines.en: Got it — sort by colour and shape.

toast: 學會分辨女人魚、男人魚、老人魚。
toastEn: You learned to tell women's fish, men's fish and elders' fish apart.

hint.zh: 男性長輩要教族男和族女分辨魚的種類。
hint.en: The man elder wants to teach the Tao man and Tao woman how to tell kinds of fish apart.

quests.labourNote: 族男捕魚、族女處理，F1 本來就是雙人分工
review: 女人魚、男人魚、老人魚的分類與飲食禁忌請族人確認；族語名稱暫不列出

name.zh: 漁獲分享給船組與親族
name.en: Share the catch with the crew and relatives

steps.text: 族男到開元港，問拼板舟漁人怎麼分這次的魚
steps.textEn: The Tao man goes to Kaiyuan Harbour and asks the plank boat fisher how to share this catch

lines.zh: 船組每個人一份，親戚家也送一點。魚是大家的。
lines.en: One share for each crew member, and a little for the relatives too. The fish belong to everyone.

steps.text: 族男把魚分送到親族家
steps.textEn: The Tao man takes fish to the relatives' homes

lines.zh: 這是我們家的一點心意。
lines.en: A little something from our family.

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 分出去的魚，以後會回到你身上。
lines.en: Fish you give away come back to you one day.

toast: 漁獲分享給船組與親族。
toastEn: The catch was shared with the crew and relatives.

hint.zh: 釣到的魚要分給船組和親族，族男去問問怎麼分。
hint.en: The fish caught should be shared with the crew and relatives. The Tao man should go ask how.

steps.text: 女性長輩交代：家裡分到的飛魚，一起曬
steps.textEn: The woman elder asks: dry the family's share of flying fish together

lines.zh: 船組分到的魚，加上親戚送來的，一共十條。都交給妳曬。
lines.en: The crew's share plus what the relatives brought makes ten. They're all yours to dry.

steps.text: 族女把十條飛魚剖開、抹鹽、掛上曬魚架
steps.textEn: The Tao woman splits ten flying fish, salts them and hangs them on the drying rack

lines.zh: ……八、九、十。全部掛好了。
lines.en: …eight, nine, ten. All hung up.

steps.text: 向女性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the woman elder

lines.zh: 十條都曬好了。今年的糧倉會很安心。
lines.en: All ten are dry. The food store will be in good shape this year.

toastEn: Ten dried flying fish are in the food store.

hint.zh: 家裡分到的飛魚，族女要一條條曬成飛魚乾。
hint.en: The Tao woman dries the family's share of flying fish, one by one.

name.zh: 釣 6 條魚並一起分類
name.en: Catch 6 fish and sort them together

text.whoEn: Tao man catches, Tao woman prepares
text.unlock: 同一趟也算 F2、魚類圖鑑
text.unlockEn: Also counts for F2, fish field guide
text.kindEn: Season + count 6 + fishing ground (Tao man catches)

steps.text: 男性長輩要族男去釣幾條魚
steps.textEn: The man elder asks the Tao man to catch a few fish

lines.zh: 冬天浪大，不出遠海。在港邊礁岩釣幾條就好，拿回家給族女分。
lines.en: Big waves in winter, so no going far out. Catch a few from the harbour rocks and bring them home for the Tao woman to sort.

steps.text: 族男在港邊的礁岩釣魚
steps.textEn: The Tao man fishes from the rocks by the harbour

lines.zh: ……四、五、六。夠了，回家。
lines.en: …four, five, six. That's enough. Home we go.

steps.text: 族女把六條魚分成女人魚和男人魚
steps.textEn: The Tao woman sorts the six fish into women's fish and men's fish

lines.zh: 這三條給我們煮，那三條另外放。
lines.en: These three are for us to cook; those three go aside.

lines.zh: 分得好快！
lines.en: That was quick!

steps.text: 向男性長輩回報
steps.textEn: Report to the man elder

lines.zh: 捕的人和分的人都做對了，這就是一家人。
lines.en: The one who caught and the one who sorted both did it right. That's a family.

hint.zh: 非飛魚季時，族男可以在港邊釣魚，帶回家給族女分類。
hint.en: Outside flying fish season, the Tao man can fish by the harbour and bring the fish home for the Tao woman to sort.

quests.labourNote: 族男捕、族女處理，G4 本來就是雙人分工

name.zh: 年終：在主人家用族語說一句今年學到的話
name.en: Year's end: say something you learned this year in Tao, at the host family's home

text.coopEn: Trio: whole party at the host family's house

steps.text: 全隊回到主人家的涼亭，一年結束
steps.textEn: The whole party returns to the host family's pavilion as the year ends

lines.zh: 一年過去了。來，坐上來，每個人用族語說一句今年學到的話。
lines.en: A year has passed. Come, sit up here. Each of you, say one thing you learned this year in Tao.

lines.zh: akokey！以前回來只敢點頭，現在敢用族語跟長輩打招呼了。
lines.en: akokey! I used to just nod when I came home. Now I can greet the elders in Tao.

lines.zh: soli、alibangbang……田裡和海上的東西，我都記得它們的名字了。
lines.en: soli, alibangbang… I remember the names of everything in the fields and at sea now.

lines.zh: Pongso no Tao，人之島。謝謝你們讓我一起回家。
lines.en: Pongso no Tao, the Island of People. Thank you for bringing me home with you.

lines.zh: 你們回來，不是只為了看看。你們記得這裡，這裡就一直是你們的家。
lines.en: You didn't come back just to look around. As long as you remember this place, it will always be your home.

lines.zh: 一個遊戲年結束了。
lines.en: A game year has ended.

toast: 回家的這一年結束了。島上的日子，還會繼續。
toastEn: The year of coming home is over. Life on the island goes on.

hint.zh: 飛魚季結束了，全隊回主人家的涼亭，跟長輩說說這一年。
hint.en: Flying fish season is over. The whole party returns to the host family's pavilion to talk with the elder about the year.
